questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki receives a patient with a long-term illness (ALD). Dr. Alami reminds him of the patient's rights. According to Article 9 of Law 65-00, what is the rule regarding the co-payment for ALDs?
options: The co-payment is maintained at 20%
The co-payment is fully or partially exempted
The co-payment is doubled
The patient must pay 50% of the care
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'In the case of a serious or disabling illness requiring long-term care, the remaining portion is fully or partially exempted.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will inform my patient of this exemption.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who wishes to add their parents to their AMO coverage. Dr. Mabrouki reminds them of the conditions. According to Article 5 of Law 65-00, under what condition can the insured request extension to their parents?
options: Automatically without additional contribution
Provided they pay for their contribution
Only if the parents are over 70 years old
Extension to parents is never possible
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Article 5 allows extension provided the insured pays for their parents' contribution.' Dr. Alami: 'I will inform them of this condition.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki treats a patient whose spouse recently passed away. Dr. Alami reminds him of the rights of dependents. According to Article 35 of Law 65-00, for how long do dependents continue to benefit from benefits?
options: For a period of six months
For a period of two years
For a period of five years
Until the end of the dependents' lives
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Article 35 provides for a maintenance of rights for two years for the dependents of the deceased insured.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will inform my patient of her rights.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a 24-year-old patient who is a university student. Dr. Mabrouki asks them to check their dependent status. According to Law 54.23, up to what age is an unmarried child pursuing higher education covered?
options: Up to age 21 without conditions
Up to age 26
Up to age 30
Until obtaining the diploma without limit
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Law 54.23 extends the coverage age for unmarried students pursuing their studies up to age 30.' Dr. Alami: 'I will ask for their school certificate.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who benefits from complementary mutual insurance. Dr. Alami asks them how coordination works. According to general rules, what is the role of complementary mutual insurance?
options: It replaces the AMO
It increases the AMO reimbursement rates
It manages the AMO for the public sector
It is reserved for cosmetic procedures
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Complementary mutual insurance companies increase the AMO reimbursement rates (e.g., 80% + 16 to 20% additional).' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will inform my patient of this complementarity.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami must perform a dental prosthesis on a patient. Dr. Mabrouki reminds them of the procedure. According to mutual insurance company rules, what administrative procedure is often necessary?
options: None, treatment is automatically covered
A prior agreement with submission of a detailed quote
A simple invoice to send after treatment
A verbal agreement with the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Dental prostheses require a prior agreement, with submission of a detailed quote before starting treatment.' Dr. Alami: 'I will prepare the quote and send it to the mutual insurance company.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who lost their AMO rights after ceasing their activity. Dr. Alami asks them to check the maintenance of rights periods. According to Article 34 of Law 65-00, how long does a person retain their rights after ceasing to meet the conditions?
options: A maximum period of six months
A period of two full years
A period of only one month
No maintenance of rights period
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Article 34 provides for a maintenance of rights for a maximum period of six months after the cessation of conditions.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will inform my patient of this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who wants to get a dental implant. Dr. Mabrouki informs them about coverage. According to the general rules of the AMO and mutual insurance companies, what is the situation?
options: The AMO reimburses the implant at 80%
The implant is not covered by the AMO, but may be covered by some mutual insurance companies
All mutual insurance companies reimburse implants without conditions
The State covers the full cost of implants
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The AMO does not cover dental implants, but some complementary mutual insurance companies may offer coverage.' Dr. Alami: 'I will refer my patient to their mutual insurance company.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who received care abroad. Dr. Alami asks them to check the reimbursement conditions. According to Article 13 of Law 65-00, what care abroad is reimbursable?
options: All care without conditions
In case of unexpected illness or lack of appropriate care in Morocco
Only for patients on business trips
No care abroad is reimbursable
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Article 13 allows reimbursement in case of unexpected illness during a stay, or when care cannot be provided in Morocco.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will check the prior agreement.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a civil servant patient affiliated with the CNOPS. Dr. Mabrouki informs them about the developments. According to Law 54.23, what major change will occur in the management of the AMO for this patient?
options: The CNOPS remains the sole manager
The management of the public sector AMO will be transferred to the CNSS
Patients will have to take out private insurance
The AMO scheme for civil servants will be abolished
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Law 54.23 provides for entrusting the management of the basic AMO scheme to a single body, the CNSS.' Dr. Alami: 'I will inform my patient of this development.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who has no AMO coverage and cannot pay their contributions. Dr. Alami advises them on the options. According to Law 65-00, which scheme can they join?
options: The basic AMO scheme
The AMO-TADAMON scheme
A mandatory private insurance
No scheme, they must pay for their care
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'The AMO-TADAMON scheme is provided for people unable to pay their contributions, with the State covering the costs.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will refer my patient to this scheme.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami must perform orthodontic treatment on a young patient. Dr. Mabrouki reminds them of the procedure. According to mutual insurance company rules, what is the recommended approach?
options: Start treatment immediately
Obtain a prior agreement with submission of a quote and an X-ray
Wait until the end of treatment to request reimbursement
Make do with a verbal agreement with the mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Orthodontics requires a prior agreement with submission of a detailed quote accompanied by an X-ray.' Dr. Alami: 'I will prepare the file for the mutual insurance company.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who changed employers (from public to private). Dr. Alami asks them how the change of manager occurs. According to AMO rules, what is the situation?
options: The patient must manually register with the CNSS
The transfer is automatic with coordination between bodies
The patient loses their coverage for 6 months
The patient must take out private insurance
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Rules of coordination between managing bodies are provided in case of mobility between sectors.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will reassure my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient affiliated with the MGPAP. Dr. Mabrouki asks them about the particularities of this mutual insurance company. According to available information, who is the MGPAP intended for?
options: Private sector employees
Public administration personnel
All citizens without conditions
Liberal professions
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The MGPAP is specific to public administration personnel.' Dr. Alami: 'I will check my patient's affiliation.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who had a traffic accident. Dr. Alami asks them to check the coverage. According to Law 65-00, how is the risk managed in case of a third-party accident?
options: The patient must bear the full cost
The managing body exercises a legal recourse against the third party
The dentist bears the total financial loss
The law prohibits any reimbursement request
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'The law allows recourse against the responsible third party to recover the costs incurred.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will refer my patient to the CNSS.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami finds that a patient has received an undue reimbursement. Dr. Mabrouki advises them to report the error. According to Article 135 of Law 65-00, what risk does a person who improperly obtains benefits face?
options: A fine of 1,000 to 5,000 dirhams
A prison sentence of 6 months
Suspension of their rights
A simple warning
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Article 135 punishes fraud or false declaration to obtain undue benefits with a fine of 1,000 to 5,000 dirhams.' Dr. Alami: 'I will report the error.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who wants aesthetic veneers. Dr. Alami reminds them of the rules. According to Law 65-00, how are these procedures covered?
options: At 80% like current care
They are excluded from the scope of the AMO as cosmetic procedures
At 100% if the dentist prescribes them
Partially depending on the mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Cosmetic surgery procedures, including aesthetic veneers, are excluded from the scope of the AMO.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will inform my patient of this exclusion.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who lost their insurance card. Dr. Mabrouki advises them to check their registration number. According to Law 65-00, is registration with the AMO mandatory?
options: No, it remains optional depending on the contract
Yes, for any person exercising an activity
Yes, only for the public sector
No, except in the case of a serious diagnosed illness
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The obligation of registration is the foundation of the AMO for any person exercising an activity.' Dr. Alami: 'I will refer my patient to the CNSS.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who benefits from RAMED. Dr. Alami asks them to check the conditions. According to Article 3 of Law 65-00, who is RAMED intended for?
options: Economically disadvantaged people not subject to the AMO
Civil servants and State agents
Self-employed liberal workers
Higher education students
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'RAMED is intended for economically disadvantaged people who do not benefit from any AMO scheme.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will check if my patient meets the conditions.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who wishes to undergo long-term treatment. Dr. Mabrouki advises them to check the reimbursement limit. According to Law 65-00, how are care coverage limits set?
options: They are set by the free choice of the practitioner
They are defined by nomenclatures of procedures
They depend on the total annual amount contributed
They are decreed by medical associations
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The nomenclature sets the reference tariffs for procedures and their coverage limits.' Dr. Alami: 'I will consult the nomenclature before treatment.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who was hospitalized. Dr. Alami asks them to check the coverage. According to Article 7 of Law 65-00, what types of care are guaranteed by the AMO?
options: Only curative care and hospitalization
Curative, preventive, rehabilitation, maternity, and dental care
Only cosmetic care
Exclusively medications
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Article 7 lists preventive, curative, rehabilitation, maternity, dental care, etc.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will check the full coverage.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who has subscribed to complementary insurance. Dr. Mabrouki asks them to coordinate the reimbursements. According to Article 9 of Law 65-00, what is the rule regarding complementary insurance?
options: The insured cannot subscribe to complementary insurance
The insured retains the freedom to subscribe to complementary insurance
Complementary insurance is mandatory
Complementary insurance is prohibited
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Article 9 specifies that the insured retains the freedom to subscribe to complementary insurance.' Dr. Alami: 'I will coordinate both coverages.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who consulted without being registered. Dr. Alami advises them to check their status. According to Article 2 of Law 65-00, to which categories of people does the AMO apply?
options: To civil servants, employees, pensioners, self-employed workers, and students
Only to private sector employees
Exclusively to State civil servants
Only to pension holders
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'The AMO applies to all these categories: civil servants, employees, pensioners, self-employed, liberal professions, students.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will check my patient's situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami must bill care to a patient with both mutual insurance and the AMO. Dr. Mabrouki advises them to respect the agreed tariffs. According to Law 65-00, what is the base tariff for reimbursement?
options: The free tariff chosen by the practitioner
The base tariff for reimbursement
The maximum tariff allowed in emergencies
The reduced tariff for low incomes
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The national tariff serves as the AMO reference for care reimbursement.' Dr. Alami: 'I will apply the national tariff.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki, after having managed several complex coverage files with Dr. Alami, receives their congratulations. What is the next step for Dr. Mabrouki?
options: Become an expert in coverage and dental mutual insurance
Retire
Change specialty
Forget good practices
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Mastery of coverage is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert is the next step.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will train in reimbursement management.'
